+    def merge_remote_ids(self, incoming_ids: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, str], int]:
+        """Return the combined identifiers and the number already on this author.
+
+        A single identifier service cannot point at two different records for
+        the same author. Leave the author unchanged if any value conflicts.
+        """
+        existing = self.get('remote_ids') or {}
+        merged = dict(existing.dict() if isinstance(existing, Thing) else existing)
+        matches = 0

+                raise AuthorRemoteIdConflictError(

+                )
+            if current == identifier:
+                matches += 1
+            else:
+                merged[service] = identifier
+        return merged, matches
